title: Tilemap
description: Paints grid-based 2D levels using a tileset image and optional solid collision. Use Tilemap to build platformer stages, top-down maps, walls, and floors.

blocks.content: The **Tilemap** component lets you paint 2D worlds onto a grid from a single tileset image. It is available on **World** entities and includes a dedicated **Tilemap Editor** tab with brush, eraser, flood-fill, eyedropper, and marquee selection tools, plus one-click solid collision for all painted tiles.

items.title: Tile Palette
items.desc: Select single tiles or drag across multiple tiles to paint full stamps at once.

items.title: Painting Tools
items.desc: Paint with the **Brush**, erase, flood fill with the **Bucket**, or pick tiles with the **Picker**.

items.title: Solid Collision
items.desc: Check **Solid** to turn painted tiles into physical walls and floors automatically.

items.title: Auto-Fit Bounds
items.desc: Automatically resizes the entity's transform bounds to match the painted tile area.

items: Select an entity inside a **World** layer in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and select **Tilemap**.
In the **Assets** panel of the bottom dock, right-click a tileset image and choose **Apply to Tilemap**.
In the **Tilemap** section of the inspector, click **Open Editor** to launch the **Tilemap Editor** tab.

blocks.message: Right-click a **World** layer in the **Scene Hierarchy**, hover over **Add Entity**, and click **Tilemap** to create a tilemap entity in one step.

blocks.content: Configure rendering and collision in the **Tilemap** section of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).

rows: Displays the tileset thumbnail and the **Open Editor** button.
Transparency percentage of the tilemap from 0% to 100%.
Texture filter mode: **Pixelated** for crisp pixel art or **Smooth** for high-resolution tiles.
When checked, all painted tiles block entities with a [Physics Body](components/physics_body) and solid [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider).

blocks.content: When you click **Open Editor**, the right panel switches to the **Tilemap Editor** with **Tile Tool**, **Tilemap Settings**, and **Tile Palette**.

rows: Box-selects painted tiles so you can move or delete them (or hold **Ctrl** while using the brush).
Paints the selected tile or multi-tile stamp onto the grid.
Erases painted tiles under the pointer.
Flood fills a bounded empty area or contiguous matching tiles.
Samples the tile under the pointer as your active brush.
Sets the cell width (**W**) and height (**H**) in pixels (default 16x16). Must be set before painting tiles.
Deletes all painted tiles from the tilemap after confirmation.

blocks.content: Build a solid ground layer and a decorative background layer by using two separate **Tilemap** entities.

items: Right-click your **World** layer in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy), hover over **Add Entity**, and click **Tilemap**. Rename its **ID** to **Tilemap_Ground**.
Assign your tileset image and click **Open Editor** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).
In **Tilemap Settings**, set **Tile Size (Px)** (**W** and **H**) to match your tileset grid (such as **16** or **32**).
In **Tile Palette**, click a tile (or drag across several tiles), press **B**, and paint your platforms on the canvas.
Close the **Tilemap Editor** tab and check **Solid** under **Collision** in the **Tilemap** section.
Create a second **Tilemap** entity with a lower **Z-Index** and leave **Solid** unchecked for background decorations.

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Rendering & Camera](node_library/game_renderer) and [Physics & Collision](node_library/game_physics) to query or update tilemaps at runtime.
